{{Top|leg}}
'''The Cave''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] situated in the floating [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], which offered patrons the opportunity to experience what life was like for a [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]. The cantina was located beneath Tolea Biqua and by utilizing both the city's rotation and artificial [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] generators, the patrons of the cantina were able to walk on the establishment's ceiling. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Melo Centris]] and some of her [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] associates visited The Cave.
